description.value: Hynes' is an Irish-owned and Irish-run pub in the Kitsilano neighbourhood, dedicated to the Hynes family of Galway and built around good Guinness, draught beers, and comfort-food cooking. It hosts traditional Irish music sessions and live musicians multiple nights a week, and offers a hireable private lounge for groups of up to 60. Weekend brunch is served Saturday and Sunday, making it a viable stop at multiple points in a cycling day.
